title: fix(core): externalize https-proxy-agent to fix proxy support

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: Calling Vertex AI / Gemini API or fallback proxy paths through an HTTP/HTTPS proxy fails with 'TypeError: HttpsProxyAgent is not a constructor' when executed from bundled ESM code.
summary.root_cause: esbuild ESM code-splitting ('splitting: true', 'format: 'esm'') converts CJS dependencies like 'https-proxy-agent' and 'http-proxy-agent' into default exports in split chunks, causing dynamic imports such as '(await import('https-proxy-agent')).HttpsProxyAgent' in 'gaxios' to resolve 'HttpsProxyAgent' to 'undefined'.
summary.context: While earlier PRs attempted explicit proxy agent injection for main auth paths, fallback proxy pathways still triggered dynamic imports. Adding esbuild aliases for 'https-proxy-agent' and 'http-proxy-agent' pointing to ESM patch re-exports preserves constructable named exports in the bundle without requiring externalization.

steps: Create patch file 'packages/cli/src/patches/http-proxy-agent.ts' that re-exports 'HttpProxyAgent' from '../../../../node_modules/http-proxy-agent/dist/index.js'.
Create patch file 'packages/cli/src/patches/https-proxy-agent.ts' that re-exports 'HttpsProxyAgent' from '../../../../node_modules/https-proxy-agent/dist/index.js'.

In 'esbuild.config.js', update the 'cliConfig.alias' mapping to resolve 'https-proxy-agent' to 'packages/cli/src/patches/https-proxy-agent.ts' and 'http-proxy-agent' to 'packages/cli/src/patches/http-proxy-agent.ts'.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Dynamic imports of bundled 'https-proxy-agent' and 'http-proxy-agent' modules expose constructable named constructor functions ('HttpsProxyAgent' and 'HttpProxyAgent').
verification_steps: Create 'scripts/tests/proxy-agent-bundle.test.ts' to build a test entry using 'esbuild.build' with 'splitting: true', 'format: 'esm'', and the patch aliases from 'cliConfig'.
Import the generated bundle output via file URL using 'pathToFileURL'.
Verify that calling 'new https.HttpsProxyAgent('http://127.0.0.1:9')' and 'new http.HttpProxyAgent('http://127.0.0.1:9')' does not throw an error.
Run 'npx vitest run scripts/tests/proxy-agent-bundle.test.ts' to confirm all tests pass.
